requirements.text: Sustained continuity for ~10 hours from issuance (2026-09-19 ~05:45 UTC to ~15:45 UTC): the orchestrator keeps the supervised build lanes continuously operating - after every clean stop (breaker trip, unit completion, run close) it executes the standard between-runs drill (deny parked asks, repair any audit-chain damage, harvest evidence) and relaunches or advances the lane without waiting for the owner; finished builds are harvested, submitted, independently reviewed, and accepted at seams per the normal gated process; a lane that finishes its packet is re-fed with the next contracted packet rather than left idle. Stops are permitted only for genuine blockers or owner-only decisions (Tier D / Section 20 / credentials / payment / production approval), which are surfaced plainly while other released lanes continue.
requirements.required_harness: The session's monitor watcher stays armed for the window; every stop within the window shows a recorded recovery (relaunch or harvest) in git/ledger/launcher state rather than an unattended dead lane.
requirements.required_evidence: git commits + ledger transitions + launcher ACTIVE-TASK/run-id history + DISCOVERY_BACKLOG seam notes covering the window
